Z = 4 and the ideal framework are not established by peak positions alone, but are jointly supported by the 1:1:1:1 composition, systematic absences, superstructure intensities, and a physically plausible fully occupied intermetallic cell. The trajectory explicitly instantiated all 24 element permutations over the four special sites: only the Yb/Ir versus Al/Ga partition fit the intensities, and the eight nominal survivors were shown to be one crystallographic structure under cubic equivalence, leaving no unresolved discrete element-ordering alternative. Although an independently comparable whole-pattern Rwp was unavailable and arbitrary lower-symmetry distortions were not exhaustively searched, the clean unsplit pattern and the complete position/intensity agreement provide no materially different, scientifically motivated candidate likely to improve the submitted set.
